thread:
anya-cs: Heads-up — Harvest (onboarding) seeing ~350ms p95 for chat and token cost ~1.2x above our projection. Renewal surfaced as medium risk if costs don't improve. Looking for quick perf levers: quantization, model swap, routing. Thoughts?

mike-eng: Do we have recent traces / sample requests? Posted the trace link: https://internal.redwood/traces/harvest/1995 — lots of short prompts + a few long-recent contexts.

raj-ml: Quick read: their conversational prompts are dominated by short (<128) sequences. On our sandbox q4_8bit variant reduced p95 by ~30% with negligible quality drop across their eval set. Regressions show up on long code-like prompts. Recommendation: canary q4_8bit for non-code routes.

sara-ops: Agree with Raj. Operationally we can also: 1) route non-interactive batch/rerank requests to a cheaper dedicated pool; 2) enable prefix/KV caching for the top 20 repetitive prompts; 3) add a canary TTL so we can revert quickly.

anya-cs: Nice. Can we draft a minimal rollout plan that keeps the customer in the loop? Prefer 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% if no regressions. Will capture explicit opt-in and produce a before/after cost delta for them.

raj-ml: Canary config sketch:
```
route: harvest-prod
variants:
  - name: fp16-control
    model: redwood-base-fp16
    percent: 90
  - name: q4-canary
    model: redwood-base-q4_8bit
    percent: 10
checks:
  - eval_set: harvest-eval-v1
    metric: response-quality-delta
    threshold: -0.02
```
We should exclude routes tagged as `codegen` from this canary.

mike-eng: I'll wire token-level tracing + diffs to the CS dashboard so we can spot quality regressions quickly. Adding a widget for per-route latency and cost delta.

product-bot: Created ticket RDW-4421 to track Harvest quant canary + routing changes. Linked docs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-4421. Assignees: raj-ml, mike-eng, anya-cs.

anya-cs: I will handle customer comms and capture feedback in Gainsight (notes + example diffs). @sara-ops can you coordinate a 30m enablement call with Harvest infra and their SRE?

sara-ops: On it — proposing Wed 11am PT, sending calendar invite and pre-read (including the rollout snippet and expected KPIs).

mike-eng: Also recommend an automatic fallback policy: if eval delta > 2% on quality metric OR 5% increase in error-rate, route back to fp16 control. Quick snippet:
`fallback_policy: on_quality_regress->fp16-control`

raj-ml: One more note: consider a small tokenization patch for their domain (handles some entity-heavy prompts) before full rollout — reduces perplexity on the q4 variant. I'll prep a PR.

anya-cs: Great. I'll update the renewal-risk board: optimistic but will mark as "monitoring" for two weeks; escalate to "at-risk" if no improvement. Thanks all :raised_hands:

mike-eng: 👍 I'll post a short status update in #customer-status when canary goes live.
